title: Jaxson Dart will allow John Harbaugh’s Giants offense to live in a lot of ‘different worlds’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaxson Dart will allow John Harbaugh’s Giants offense to live in a lot of ‘different worlds’
sources.description: Dart is not Lamar Jackson — Harbaugh’s quarterback the past eight seasons — and the Giants’ offense will not attempt to wholly replicate what was seen in Baltimore all those years.
